title: Global augmented extended Cech model
statement: For a small site (C,J), a sheaf of commutative rings O, a finite type ideal module I with monomorphism ι into O, and the required derived-category instances, there exist a complex K of O-module sheaves and an augmentation ε : K ⟶ O[0] having HasLocalExtendedCechDescription O I ι K ε.

proof.text: Restrict to the full subsite of objects on which the finite type ideal has a finite generating list. The special-cocontinuous site equivalence identifies sheaves and derived module categories with those on the subsite. On each slice define the sheafified functorial ring complex from the finite-generator ring construction; independence of finite generating lists follows after a covering on which the generated ideals agree. The restriction compatibilities glue these complexes and their augmentations to a global K. The sequential-localization comparison and its augmentation compatibility remain the unresolved construction in this theorem.
